title: Shadow Enrollment
description: An agent's enrollment in Shadow Mode plus the Reliability Evidence accumulated against it. A shadow agent runs in perpetual dry-run alongside human operators; every invocation is a row of evidence. When the evidence clears the AutonomyPolicy's promotion bar, an ADR proposal promotes the agent to autonomous.

agent.description: Canonical agent name enrolled in shadow mode.

status.description: shadow = actively shadowing; promoted = an accepted ADR moved it to autonomous; withdrawn = removed from shadow mode.

evidence.description: Aggregated Reliability Evidence over the shadow ledger.

observedRuns.description: Runs that have a human-comparison observation.

matchedRuns.description: Observed runs where the projection matched the human action.

agreementRate.description: matchedRuns / observedRuns, or 0 when nothing has been observed.

distinctTraces.description: Distinct W3C trace IDs the shadow runs span.

promotionGate.description: Evaluation of the AutonomyPolicy promotion requirements against the evidence.
